newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana share index firms slightly but demand weak.
newsitem.headline: Ghana share index firms slightly but demand weak.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange closed the week firmer on Friday but demand was weak in the run-up to next month's national elections, dealers said.
The All-Share Index rose 0.60 points 366.37 points from 365.77 on Wednesday at the end of a week of losses.
Only 17,820 shares changed hands. Offers outstripped demand by 873,670 to 229,020. Aluworks Limited (+60 cedis to 1,410 cedis) and Social Security Bank (+2 to 1,050 cedis) were the two risers.
Fan Milk Limited (-2 to 404 cedis) was the only stock to fall.
The index slipped 0.12 points in Wednesday's trading and 1.54 points on Monday.
Dealers say investors have adopted a wait-and-see attitude in the runup to presidential and parliamentary elections on December 7.
